title_zh: 约定自带舞台化妆品供负责人看效果

scenario.label_zh: 确认舞台化妆用品与效果核对安排
scenario.goal_zh: 尊重演员不共用化妆品的选择，约定自带用品并在排练时让负责人核对效果

context_zh: 英国业余剧团演员弗洛拉与服装负责人乔安讨论排练用品。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Flora
sentences.text: Do we all have to use the same make-up for the show? I'd rather bring my own.

sentences.speaker: Joan
sentences.text: That's fine. We need a similar appearance, not shared products.

sentences.speaker: Flora
sentences.text: My usual foundation is lighter than the one in the costume box. Will that be a problem under the lights?

sentences.speaker: Joan
sentences.text: Let's look at it during the lighting rehearsal rather than guess now.

sentences.speaker: Flora
sentences.text: I'll bring my own products on Wednesday and arrive a little early.

sentences.speaker: Joan
sentences.text: Good. I'll check the effect with you before the rehearsal starts; you don't need to use anything from the shared box.
